allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-Process java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize" 2>/dev/null)

Bash(powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id 12220,22500 -Force" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; powershell -Command "Get-Process java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id | Format-Table -AutoSize" 2>/dev/null)

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \\"Name='java.exe'\\" | Where-Object { \\$_.CommandLine -like '*carlink*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id \\$_.ProcessId -Force }" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "app stopped")
